test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Netaji, a hero of Modern India, is remembered for his contribution in the establishment of Indian Army.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before the term "**Indian Army**."
 
• Proper nouns like **"Indian Army"** typically require the definite article** "the" **before them.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the establishment of the Indian Army**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Netaji, a hero of Modern India, is remembered for his contribution in **the establishment of the Indian Army**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "his contribution in the," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "Netaji, a hero of Modern,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "India, is remembered for,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
